description: This Java class 'ProductMixDataValidator' validates JSON data related to product mix configurations, specifically handling 'restrictedProducts' parameters for create and update operations within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: ProductMixDataValidator
classes.description: A final class responsible for validating JSON data related to product mix, especially 'restrictedProducts' parameter, for create and update operations.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for creating a product mix, checking for unsupported parameters, parsing JSON, and validating 'restrictedProducts' array.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for updating a product mix, similar to create validation but without checking array contents.

methods.name: validateRestrictedProducts
methods.description: Validates each restricted product ID to ensure it is not blank and greater than zero.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws a validation exception if any validation errors are accumulated.
